brief:
Israeli aircraft carried out airstrikes Sunday on multiple towns in southern Lebanon, including Arabasileen, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, and Kafr Rimman, the Shehab Wire reported. The military said the strikes were in response to two drones launched toward its forces operating in the area.

The incidents underscore escalating tensions along the Lebanon-Israel border. Sunday's exchange followed a pattern of cross-border incidents involving armed groups based in southern Lebanon and Israeli military operations targeting the region. The identities of those responsible for launching the drones remained unclear, though Israeli officials attributed the attack to hostile forces in the area.
